description: Deterministic response with a fixed 3s silent gap before any session/update notification, used by the mitto-sus.11 queue-store perf isolation scenario (tests/ui/specs/perf/render-isolation.perf.spec.ts) to keep the agent busy (isStreaming=true, so a REST-queued message is never auto-processed) WITHOUT any chunk delivery -- avoids conflating queueStore isolation with the ongoing per-chunk re-renders a real streaming response would cause. Short, unique, case-sensitive literal trigger (no wildcards) so it reliably wins findMatchingResponse's shortest-match-span selection against broader wildcarded fixtures that can coincidentally match Mitto's injected preamble text (see handler.go's findMatchingResponse doc comment).
